component.name: euro-office
component.description: TAPPaaS module euro-office: generated from euro-office-components.json; do not edit.

analysis.detail: euro-office/deb:apt. APT download/redirect flaw; apt never runs in the running container, supervisord starts only nginx, the Node services, PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ. Verified live on hrossen with documentserver:v9.3.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.

euro-office/deb:brotli. Only the nginx master maps libbrotlidec, through the image_filter module's libgd and libfreetype (freetype uses brotli only for WOFF2 fonts); image_filter is loaded but used in no server block, so nginx never draws text with a font, and nginx does not brotli-decode request bodies. The document converter (x2t) links no system brotli or freetype, and curl is used without --compressed. Verified live on hrossen with documentserver:v9.3.7. Decided by migration 2026-11-12; review by 2027-05-11.
